Most comprehensive air and gas treatment portfolio: From separators and regenerative and adsorption dryers to refrigerated dryers, BAUER covers all air and gas purity requirements in accordance with DIN ISO 8573-1. Global market leadership & service expertise: BAUER is the global market standard in high- and medium-pressure applications across nearly all segments – with a 70% market share in breathing air systems and an undisputed leading position in industrial applications, supported by a global service network. What is the G22 series used for in helium applications? The G22 series comprises air-cooled high-pressure compressors for industrial helium compression. It is used wherever helium needs to be reliably compressed from atmospheric pressure to high final pressures or reprocessed within recovery systems, for example in industrial processes, research facilities, test benches and gas recovery plants. What performance ranges does the G22 series cover for helium? Depending on the configuration, the high-pressure versions of the G22 series achieve final pressures of up to 350 bar. The effective delivery rates range from approximately 620 to 1,500 litres per minute, depending on the model. This makes the series suitable for both compact helium applications and high-capacity recovery and supply systems. How are the G22 high-pressure compressors controlled and monitored? The compressors are equipped with the B-CONTROL MICRO control system.
